data.name: Brawl Squad X: Battle Arena
data.detailed_description:
🔥 Brawl Squad X: Battle Arena

Brawl Squad X: Battle Arena is a Top-Down Shooter built for relentless action and instant fun. Designed as a top down multiplayer shooter, it blends tactical top-down combat with fast-paced action shooter intensity, delivering an explosive 3D shooter experience that’s easy to jump into and hard to put down.

With responsive controls inspired by the twin stick shooter formula, every match feels precise, chaotic, and rewarding — a true fast paced top down shooter made for modern players.

🧠 Offline Combat & AI Warfare

Play fully offline against AI-controlled enemies in a complete offline shooter experience featuring offline PvP, bot support, and a full offline multiplayer experience. Jump into single-player team deathmatch, AI skirmish, a dedicated practice mode shooter designed as a full combat training simulator.

Face tactical bot AI in offline shooter vs bots encounters, train in a practice vs bots shooter, and sharpen your skills in a solo shooter vs AI environment. This is a true shooter with bots, offering competitive offline play with full progression enabled and shared progression across modes.

🌐 Online Multiplayer & Match Variety

Jump online in an online multiplayer shooter built around tight matchmaking and instant action. Fight real players in an online PvP shooter, dominate in team deathmatch (TDM),  jump into a full team deathmatch shooter designed for both large team-based battles and smaller fast paced firefights.

🎯 Loadouts, Classes & Playstyles

Build your identity in a deep class-based shooter system with optional hero shooter elements. Unlock weapons, experiment with weapon customization, and master loadout management to support different playstyles — from aggressive rushers to tactical controllers.

Chain eliminations using power-ups, dominate with skill-based combat, and experience fast gunplay tuned for both casual and competitive play. Every match delivers action packed shooter energy with arcade-style warfare pacing.

⚔️ Competitive, Accessible, and Hardcore

Designed as a competitive top down shooter, Brawl Squad X also embraces pick-up-and-play action, making it a perfect casual multiplayer shooter that still satisfies hardcore shooter fans. It’s an easy to learn hard to master shooter built around fairness, speed, and mastery.

Optimized as a low-spec shooter, a low poly shooter, it runs smoothly on laptops and handhelds. Whether played online or solo, it remains a couch friendly shooter and a polished indie shooter experience.

🎮 Identity & Scale

This arena shooter blends the feel of a military shooter with the intensity of a military skirmish game, offering large maps / huge maps alongside compact combat zones. While inspired by classic first-person perspective gunplay philosophy, it reimagines it through a modern top down indie shooter lens.

As an indie multiplayer shooter, it delivers arcade shooter multiplayer chaos, arcade style shooter flow, and moments of pure chaotic multiplayer shooter energy — all while remaining a focused team based shooter.

Fast rounds. Tactical chaos. Total control.

A multiplayer focused shooter built for players who want speed, strategy, and nonstop action.

🔮 Expanding Game Modes & Features

The experience is designed to grow over time, with additional modes and systems planned or under consideration, such as Free For All, Domination, and more objective-based match types. The team is also exploring expanded custom game options, a server browser, and optional killstreak-style power-ups, giving players more ways to shape their PvP top-down shooter experience.

🎖️ Soldiers, Classes & Character Customization

Choose from tons of selectable soldiers inspired by classic and modern military units. Customize your character and jump into battle as WW1 soldiers, WW2 soldiers, or modern-era troops, including infantry units, special forces, commandos, riflemen, snipers, heavy gunners, and support-style roles.

The roster draws from iconic military classes and battlefield roles, letting players experiment with different combat identities — from frontline assault fighters to tactical backline specialists. Each soldier brings a distinct look and feel, reinforcing immersion in a stylized military shooter setting.

Whether you prefer grounded boots-on-the-ground combat or themed units inspired by large-scale warfare concepts like armored divisions, tank crews, helicopter units, and battlefield support roles, the game emphasizes visual variety and flexible playstyles through extensive character customization.

🔫 Weapons Arsenal & Gun Variety

Fight with a massive arsenal featuring tons of weapons inspired by iconic firearms across eras. The game includes a wide selection of assault rifles, submachine guns (SMGs), shotguns, sniper rifles, light machine guns (LMGs), pistols, and heavy weapons, giving players freedom to experiment with different combat styles.

The weapon lineup draws inspiration from classic WW1 guns, WW2 guns, and modern military firearms, blending recognizable silhouettes with fast, arcade-focused handling. From close-quarters burst weapons to long-range precision rifles, every gun is tuned for fast gunplay and responsive combat.

Players can unlock weapons through gameplay and fine-tune their approach using loadout management and weapon customization, reinforcing distinct roles in this skill-based shooter. Whether you prefer aggressive run-and-gun tactics or controlled, tactical engagements, the arsenal supports a wide range of different playstyles.

Designed for clarity and impact, the weapons emphasize readability and punch, delivering the feel of a stylized military skirmish game with arcade-style warfare pacing rather than realism overload.

🎨 Visual Style & Presentation

The game features a 3D low-poly art style with a stylized, cartoony, and slightly funny tone that keeps combat readable and fast. Inspired by classic WW1 and WW2 themes, the visuals blend military aesthetics with exaggerated proportions, bold colors, and clean silhouettes for instant clarity in chaotic fights.

This low poly shooter approach ensures smooth performance and strong visibility, reinforcing the arcade feel while giving the game a distinct stylized war game identity that stands out from realistic military shooters.

⭐ Wishlist now and stay updated on upcoming features and release news.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (x64) - Windows 11 (x64)
  • Processor: Dual-Core 2.2 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 capable GPU, Intel HD Graphics 5100 / AMD Radeon 77XX / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: High Sierra 10.13+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable GPU, Intel Iris Pro 5200 or AMD/Nvidia equivalent for Mac
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux Ubuntu 12.04 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 200 Series or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
